fragrance-world-bois-de-bois.scentSummary: Peppery, herbal woody opening (pepper, basil) over vetiver and dry woods with a cool minty edge, per retailer note lists. No community data was reachable yet (released late 2025).

manual.source: Suggested from retailer note lists (pepper, basil, vetiver, mint, woods) — not community data. Edit these tags in Collection.

maison-alhambra-eternal-touch.notesOnFit: Parfumo lists this bottle as "Eternal Touch / Tobacco Touch": reviewers say it is the earlier Tobacco Touch re-bottled, so the 73 ratings pool both names.

french-avenue-liquid-brun.notesOnFit: Parfumo also lists a 2025 Limited Edition (separate page, fewer votes). These numbers are for the 2024 original.

french-avenue-vulcan-feu.notesOnFit: Parfumo files this as "Feu" in French Avenue's Vulcan collection.

arabiyat-prestige-marwa-extrait.notesOnFit: The Extrait (2026) has its own Parfumo page; the 2025 Eau de Parfum is a separate, much more voted release and is not used here.

aromatix-french-avenue-forbidden-fruit.notesOnFit: Parfumo files it under French Avenue in the Aromatix collection.
